description: Fixes quality-of-life issues with the user interface, specifically targeting the market and cargo lists. It collapses all cargo buttons and extends them when hovered over, creating space for nine buttons in a single row. This adjustment prevents the player storage button from misaligning with other cargo controls.

discordPostHtml:
QOL UI fixes, starting with the market / cargo list.

Have you ever noticed that the storage button doesn't seem to align with any other cargo buttons? Has it made you mad? This is the mod for you!

Collapses all cargo buttons and extends them on hover, making space for 9 buttons in one row. Stops the player storage button from getting fucked.

Requires Patchlib.
